findings.evidence: This is a **process** skill: a fixed sequence — read, checklist, edit-or-escalate per finding, summarize — not a body of standing knowledge to browse.
findings.fix: Delete the self-classification sentence; the sequence below already shows the process.

findings.evidence: ## Common Mistakes restates the editing and escalation rules without a Gotchas section.
findings.fix: Add a short Gotchas list for environment facts the rules do not cover, such as resolving relative paths against the caller codebase root rather than CWD, and that a worktree root is often not the main checkout.

findings.evidence: Description names the checklist, CRITICAL/HIGH, framework profiles and Fix Summary, but not the near-miss of rewriting a plan or fixing code.
findings.fix: Use when a review report from ai-kit-spec-review-checklist (or equivalent structured review feedback with Location and Required lines) exists and the design or plan document must be edited in place. Address every CRITICAL and HIGH finding, keep the source framework's conventions when a framework profile is provided, escalate strategy decisions, and emit a per-finding Fix Summary. Use even when the user says "apply the review" or "fix the flagged sections" without naming the skill. Not for writing the review, rewriting an unreviewed plan, proofreading, or fixing code or tests.
Point the scenario record at evals/files/ in this skill, or delete the stale shared-fixture path so an agent does not load a directory that is not the current input set.

findings.evidence: keep its conventions: requirement syntax (EARS `WHEN…SHALL`, RFC-2119 SHALL), acceptance-criteria format (Given/When/Then), task-checkbox format and markers (`[P]`, `- [ ] N.N`), delta section headers
findings.fix: State the default: apply only the convention the provided profile names for the flagged section, and do not invent EARS, Given/When/Then, or checkbox markers when the profile is none.

findings.evidence: 10 should-trigger and 10 should-not-trigger queries, but several negatives are obvious (translate, rate, summarize) and near-misses are thin.
findings.fix: Replace the obvious negatives with near-misses: fixing a code-review comment, revising a plan with no review report, applying a checklist to write the review, and editing a design before any report exists.

findings.evidence: edge-medium-only-skipped and edge-inline-document have "files": [] and no report fixture, so the skip-versus-defer and inline-refusal branches are not runnable from inputs.
findings.fix: Add a one-MEDIUM-finding report fixture and an inline-document prompt that includes the pasted text plus a report path, and point both evals at those files.

findings.evidence: A MEDIUM or LOW finding is a task if trivial; otherwise defer it
findings.fix: Define trivial as a wording change inside the named Location that needs no new claim, and say that a MEDIUM or LOW finding you disagree with is skipped, not deferred.

findings.evidence: Inline report text is accepted only as a fallback; if given, the first thing this skill does is write it verbatim to a temp file
findings.fix: Name the temp path and say the write is the report only: a document to edit that arrives inline still fails with no edits, and is never written out.
